title: Rubrics satisfied in a spec should be elevatable to project-scope runs rubric
description: When a spec requires a criterion (e.g. all unit tests pass, no tool errors), that rubric is stored only on the spec file. If the same criterion should apply to all future runs, there is no mechanism to promote it to the global runs rubric. This means universally-applicable quality gates accumulate in spec files rather than being enforced project-wide.
proposed_resolution: Provide a workflow step (or moeb rubric promote command) to elevate a spec-scoped rubric into the project-scope global.rubrics.md. The promoted rubric should carry an elevated_from field referencing the originating spec. The verify_rubrics tool and complete_review process should apply elevated rubrics to all subsequent runs. Document the promotion convention in the rubrics README.
resolution_summary: Superseded by a1000118: the CLI-command approach was never implemented and is not the desired mechanism. a1000118 captures the correct approach: persona-driven promotion during the QA Architect qualitative review phase, with a rubric_scope field in the spec schema as the structured input.
